questions.question_text: Round context: Your priority score is {{ score }}. Four prizes are available this round: Prize A worth ${{ value_A }}, Prize B worth ${{ value_B }}, Prize C worth ${{ value_C }}, Prize D worth ${{ value_D }}. The mechanism: players are ordered by priority score (highest first); each player in turn receives her top-ranked remaining prize. Ties in priority are broken at random. Rank these four prizes from your top choice (most preferred) to your bottom choice (least preferred).
